primary.selection: Requested primary usable checkpoint; not selected/tuned from this evaluation
caveats: The pretrained publisher training images/splits are unavailable; overlap with this cohort cannot be excluded.
Tinea is mapped approximately to reference Ringworm; the separate254image comparison excludes this alias.
Unknown Normal combines unknown and normal; it is always rejected and never verifies healthy skin.
Reference SCIN labels are dermatologist differentials, not confirmed diagnoses.
Scores and abstention heuristics are uncalibrated and cannot identify all unsupported diseases.
No diagnosis, prescription, clinical approval, or patient independence is established.

notes: Exploratory second-candidate comparison; no independent final holdout or training-overlap guarantee.
Native exact disease names plus tinea/ringworm alias only; composite labels and subtypes remain outside-reference errors.
Publisher HF loading example does not match the verified torchvision state keys; strict standard architecture loading used.

prompts: This is a skin image of acne
This is a skin image of eczema
This is a skin image of psoriasis
This is a skin image of rosacea
This is a skin image of ringworm
This is a skin image of healthy skin
make.cohortUse: Exploratory model selection, not independent final holdout
make.labelScope: Closed six-candidate zero-shot classification; not a trained six-class classifier; Normal not clinically verified
make.preprocess:
Compose(
    Resize(size=224, interpolation=bicubic, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    CenterCrop(size=(224, 224))
    MaybeConvertMode()
    MaybeToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073], std=[0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711])
)
